io.name: areset
io.description: Asynchronous reset, active high. Conversion begins when released (deasserted) and stops when asserted.

io.name: x
io.description: Serial input bit, least-significant bit first.

io.name: z
io.description: Serial output bit of the 2's complement of the input number.

functional_summary.overview: One-input one-output serial 2's complementer Moore state machine. Input x is a serial bit stream beginning with the least-significant bit; output z is the 2's complement of the input number, produced one bit per clock cycle. The machine accepts arbitrary-length inputs. Conversion begins when areset is released and stops when areset is asserted.
rules: On asynchronous assertion of areset (active high), the machine enters the initial state and z is driven to 0.
While areset is asserted, the machine remains in the initial state and ignores x.
After areset is released, on each positive clock edge the machine samples x and transitions according to the 2's complement algorithm.
2's complement algorithm: copy input bits from LSB upward until (and including) the first 1 bit is seen; after that, invert each subsequent input bit.
State S0 (initial): output z = 0; on x=0 stay in S0; on x=1 go to S1.
State S1 (past first 1): output z = 1; on x=0 stay in S1; on x=1 stay in S1 (output remains 1).
Output z is a Moore output determined solely by the current state, with one clock cycle latency from the sampled input edge.
The machine supports input numbers of arbitrary length; no length limit is imposed.
